itinerary.title: Hotel pick-up
itinerary.text: We pick you up from your hotel in a comfortable air-conditioned vehicle. The main port, where our yachts depart from, is in the Old Town area. The drive takes around 30 minutes, depending on your hotel's location.

itinerary.title: Time at the port
itinerary.text: Final preparations before departure include arranging insurance, police permits and a final check of the yachts. In the meantime, you can rent any equipment you need for swimming and snorkelling.

itinerary.title: Comfortable yachts
itinerary.text: We have some of the most comfortable yachts in Sharm El Sheikh. The yachts are spacious and accommodate around 35 guests each. They feature open sun decks, shaded areas and two toilets.

itinerary.title: The cruise begins
itinerary.text: The yacht sets off from the port into the open waters of the Red Sea for a relaxing 1.5-hour cruise to the first stop.

itinerary.title: White Island
itinerary.text: White Island, often called the Egyptian Maldives, is part of Ras Mohamed National Park. This small sandbank is covered with fine white sand and appears only at low tide. You reach it by swimming, and for those who can't swim, the instructor will help you across with a life ring.

itinerary.title: Snorkelling and swimming
itinerary.text: The next two stops at Ras Mohamed are rich in coral reefs and marine life, making them ideal for snorkelling, diving and swimming. Each stop lasts around 1 hour 30 minutes. A snorkelling and diving instructor stays with you in the water throughout.

itinerary.title: Diving
itinerary.text: Diving is optional and available for an additional £10 when booked through the website. Each dive lasts 10–15 minutes to a depth of up to 7 metres. All dives are led by certified instructors. You can do up to three dives during the day. The minimum age is 10, and no swimming experience is required.

itinerary.title: Lunch and drinks
itinerary.text: During the trip, you'll enjoy lunch with chicken, meatballs, potatoes, pasta, rice, salads and bread. Soft drinks are available throughout the day.

itinerary.title: Return to port
itinerary.text: At the end of the trip, the yacht returns to the port at around 5:30 PM.

itinerary.title: Transfer to your hotel
itinerary.text: We'll take you back to your hotel in a comfortable air-conditioned vehicle. Arrival is between 6:00 and 6:30 PM, depending on your hotel's location.

faq.q: What should I bring?
faq.a: Bring a swimsuit or swimming trunks, a towel and a photo of your passport on your phone. You can bring your own mask, snorkel and fins or rent them at the port for £3–4 per item. We also recommend applying sunscreen before the trip.

faq.q: What time does the tour run?
faq.a: The tour runs daily from 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM . We'll pick you up from your hotel in the morning and return you between 6:00 and 6:30 PM, depending on your hotel's location.

faq.a: The minimum age is 7 years. Children under 14 must fly with an adult. The maximum combined weight is 140 kg, depending on weather conditions.

faq.q: What's the difference between single and tandem flights?
faq.a: A single flight is for one person, while a tandem flight allows two people to fly together, making it perfect for couples, friends or a parent and child.

faq.q: Will I get wet?
faq.a: Not unless you want to. If conditions allow, the captain can gently dip your feet into the water before lifting you back into the air.

faq.q: Can I bring my phone or camera?

faq.q: What happens if the weather is bad?
